youtube.notes: Use yt-dlp's public watch-page comment extraction after visible-page validation; retain video/comment provenance and do not use private or authenticated endpoints.

baidu_tieba.notes: Capture every visible virtual-scroll window before it is replaced.

stackexchange.license: CC BY-SA; preserve canonical URLs and public author attribution in the private provenance audit.

fandom_discussions.notes: Use public discussion posts and replies after recording the community terms/license page.

hupu.notes: Normal browser navigation only. Do not run a bulk crawler or call hidden endpoints; preserve thread URLs.
